$comment: Canonical catalog of the 14 Stations of the Cross, in order. imageKey doubles as the filename stem under Shared/Images/{imageKey} and as the stem of the bundle-local content keys (station01Title/station01Body ... station14Title/station14Body). Source of truth: Shared/content/stationsOfTheCross/ (devotion.json + content/<lang>.json) — no platform carries a hardcoded StationsCatalog or StationsTranslations anymore; the whole devotion is a generic bundle. Keep in sync — see README.md in this directory.

images.note: All 14 stations: Gebhard Fugel (1863-1939), Kreuzweg (1921), St. Antonius, Bad Saulgau — public domain; photographs by Andreas Praefcke, released into the public domain. Shipped inside the bundle; see Shared/Images/CREDITS.md.

languages.note: The bundle manifest declares what it ships; an undeclared language falls back to the bundle's Latin content via resolveBodyText. The 14 Liguori meditations need a verifiable published translation per language before more are declared.

stations.title: Simon of Cyrene Helps Jesus Carry the Cross
Veronica Wipes the Face of Jesus
Jesus Meets the Women of Jerusalem
Jesus is Stripped of His Garments
Jesus is Nailed to the Cross
Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross
Jesus is Laid in the Tomb

sharedPrayerKeys.$comment: Bundle-local keys reused across all 14 stations (composed into each stationNNBody at authoring time) — no longer PrayerKey cases; see content-keys.json's comment.
